note: What a server sends to change one thing about a spell already in a unit's slot. The kind settles what follows it, and only the kind that sets a name is recorded. The header names the unit this is about.

bits.name: slot
bits.note: Which slot. A champion's own spells count from 0.

bits.name: summonerSlots
bits.note: Set where the slot counts among the summoner slots rather than the champion's own. Sent set with a summoner spell's name for slots 0 and 1, a client showed nothing in either summoner slot, so what it selects is not settled.

fields.name: kind
fields.note: Which thing about the spell is being changed, and so which shape follows.

0.name: targeting
0.note: Sets how the spell is aimed; one byte follows.

2.name: range
2.note: Sets how far it is cast; a float follows.

5.name: icon
5.note: Sets which icon it shows; one byte follows.

6.name: offsetTargets
6.note: Sets the units it is cast from; a count and that many units follow.

fields.name: name
fields.note: The name the client loads the spell under, ended by a zero byte. Sent for the champion's slot 0 with the name of its fourth spell, a client showed that spell's icon in the slot.

fields.name: range
fields.note: How far the spell is cast.

fields.name: targets
fields.note: The units the spell is cast from.

bits.name: summonerSpell
bits.note: Set where the slot is a summoner slot rather than one of the unit's own.

fields.name: kind
fields.note: Which thing about the spell is being changed, and so which shape follows. Only the kind that sets a name is recorded, and what follows any other is not recorded here.

fields.name: name
fields.note: The name the client loads the spell under. Written out in full and padded with zero bytes to the width above.
